description: This file defines the class DefaultDeleteConfig, which implements the DeleteConfig interface. It provides configuration settings related to delete operations, including whether to delete events and namespaces, based on external configuration input.

classes.name: DefaultDeleteConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of DeleteConfig that loads delete-related configuration settings from a given Config object, including options to delete events and namespaces.

methods.name: DefaultDeleteConfig.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultDeleteConfig from a Config object, using a predefined configuration path and handling fallback logic.

methods.name: isDeleteEvent
methods.description: Returns whether delete events are enabled as per the configuration.

methods.name: isDeleteNamespace
methods.description: Returns whether delete namespace operations are enabled as per the configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultDeleteConfig instances based on deleteEvent and deleteNamespace flags.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on deleteEvent and deleteNamespace.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration instance, listing delete settings.
